exports.mechanismInventory: (level) => instances and applicable counters by mechanism
exports.auditMechanismParticipation: (level, drags, replay, stage, targets) => per-instance action evidence

options.runtime: optional loaded runtime; reuse for a batch
options.priorLevel: optional exact old slot object; returns hash-bound priorComparison
options.maxAttempts: default12, bounded to24 route-compatible adaptation plans
options.targets: optional explicit per-mechanism capacity policy; record any adjustment publicly
options.microBudget: maxReachable default512 (<=10000), maxTransitions default4096 (<=100000); single-held reachability only

limitations: Foundation geometry stages must use the global layout factory, not this decorator.
Generator needs 2/3/4 real nonoverlapping three-rail rim mounts; no outboard workaround.
Counter-bearing instances must have at least two distinct release events.
Single-layer lifts retain count1 metadata because revised lifts trigger on vacancy, not that counter. Intensity comes from actual independent lift regions and hidden inventory.
Bomb fuse increases are time relaxation; activity/number and real deadline traces are recorded without claiming a lower bound.
Failure never silently downgrades instance or count targets; select a suitable different base.
